title: Woven ceramic fiber optic strip from Roswell seen in a Wisconsin store

tellings.quote: I I've personally seen the fiber optics when as I describe in my book when I was in the sixth the summer after my sixth between my fifth and sixth grade when Ray Palmer the edi I believe that was his name the editor of flank saucers magazine in a store in London Wisconsin and his childhood friend who ran the store came back from Roswell with a stretch about a yard long and it was it was woven.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, the secret Air Force base in Nevada, says that as a boy, the summer between fifth and sixth grade, he saw a woven strip of fiber optics about a yard long in a store in London, Wisconsin. He says it was brought back from Roswell, the New Mexico site of a reported 1947 crash, by a man he believes was Ray Palmer, editor of Flying Saucers magazine, and by Palmer's childhood friend who ran the store. Hall tells it first-hand, as he also does in his book, and if true it would mean material from the crash was passed around privately.
